title: Nemotron-Math: Efficient Long-Context Distillation of Mathematical Reasoning from Multi-Mode Supervision
authors_zh: Du, Wei、Toshniwal, Shubham、Kisacanin, Branislav、Mahdavi, Sadegh、Moshkov, Ivan、Armstrong, George、Ge, Stephen、Minasyan, Edgar、Chen, Feng、Gitman, Igor

why: Existing math supervision rarely combines several reasoning budgets, very long traces, community questions, and tool-integrated variants under one comparable schema.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing math supervision rarely combines several reasoning budgets, very long traces, community questions, and tool-integrated variants under one comparable schema.

Nemotron-Math generates six supervision modes per source family and packages expected answers and provenance for long-context distillation. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives answer verification, majority-answer correction metadata, source curation, and matched downstream tests; the direct output is Nemotron-Math-v2, consumed by long-context mathematical reasoning SFT rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2512.15489; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data Nemotron-Math-v2 at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-Math-v2; scale 7.5 million solution traces over 85,000 AoPS and 262,000 Math StackExchange problems; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

既有数学监督很少在同一结构中同时提供多种推理预算、超长轨迹、社区问题和工具集成版本。

该工作为两类题源生成高、中、低三档推理，并分别提供有无 Python 工具的版本，同时保存预期答案与来源。 判定边界是记录能否通过“答案验证、多数答案修正标记、来源筛选和匹配下游测试”并成为长上下文数学推理监督微调的输入；直接产物是 Nemotron-Math-v2，不是只用于评测的基准。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2512.15489，日期与状态为 2025 年预印本；开放数据为 Nemotron-Math-v2，规模是750 万条解答轨迹，覆盖 8.5 万道 AoPS 题与 26.2 万道 Math StackExchange 题；已于 2026-07-27 核验全文、官方说明、条款、字段和一条实际公开记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Nemotron-Math generates six supervision modes per source family and packages expected answers and provenance for long-context distillation. Relative to OpenMathReasoning on matched AoPS questions, it changes the reusable target to uuid, problem, expected answers, source, messages, majority-change flag, and use split and makes answer verification, majority-answer correction metadata, source curation, and matched downstream tests the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

该工作为两类题源生成高、中、低三档推理，并分别提供有无 Python 工具的版本，同时保存预期答案与来源。 相比在相同 AoPS 题目上的 OpenMathReasoning，它把“记录编号、题目、预期答案、来源、消息、多数修正标记和用途切分”变成可复用目标，并以“答案验证、多数答案修正标记、来源筛选和匹配下游测试”作为反馈边界，因此中心贡献属于 Track 01 数据，而不是只发布模型、验证器或基准。

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: curated AoPS and Math StackExchange problems. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: gpt-oss-120b generates high, medium, and low reasoning modes with and without Python TIR. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as uuid, problem, expected answers, source, messages, majority-change flag, and use split and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply answer verification, majority-answer correction metadata, source curation, and matched downstream tests. Output and transition: Passing records form 7.5 million solution traces over 85,000 AoPS and 262,000 Math StackExchange problems stored as Parquet records and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for long-context mathematical reasoning SFT and compare with OpenMathReasoning on matched AoPS questions. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是筛选后的 AoPS 与 Math StackExchange 问题。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由gpt-oss-120b 生成三档推理及有无 Python 工具的六种模式。输出是按“记录编号、题目、预期答案、来源、消息、多数修正标记和用途切分”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行答案验证、多数答案修正标记、来源筛选和匹配下游测试。输出是通过检查的750 万条解答轨迹，覆盖 8.5 万道 AoPS 题与 26.2 万道 Math StackExchange 题，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于长上下文数学推理监督微调，并与在相同 AoPS 题目上的 OpenMathReasoning比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: On matched AoPS prompts Nemotron-Math consistently beats OpenMathReasoning, while StackExchange data improves HLE-Math; sequential bucketing trains 128K context 2-3x faster without significant reported loss. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 7.5 million solution traces over 85,000 AoPS and 262,000 Math StackExchange problems and exposes actual fields uuid, problem, expected answers, source, messages, majority-change flag, and use split; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 4578 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：在匹配 AoPS 题目上，Nemotron-Math 持续超过 OpenMathReasoning；加入 StackExchange 数据提升 HLE-Math，顺序分桶还把 128K 上下文训练加速 2 至 3 倍且未报告显著损失。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含750 万条解答轨迹，覆盖 8.5 万道 AoPS 题与 26.2 万道 Math StackExchange 题，实际字段是“记录编号、题目、预期答案、来源、消息、多数修正标记和用途切分”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 4578 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is OpenMathReasoning on matched AoPS questions. The paper changes the reusable object by making uuid, problem, expected answers, source, messages, majority-change flag, and use split explicit and coupling it to answer verification, majority-answer correction metadata, source curation, and matched downstream tests. That is a direction signal because another team can train long-context mathematical reasoning SFT from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是在相同 AoPS 题目上的 OpenMathReasoning。真正变化是把“记录编号、题目、预期答案、来源、消息、多数修正标记和用途切分”显式化，并与“答案验证、多数答案修正标记、来源筛选和匹配下游测试”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练长上下文数学推理监督微调，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When majority-answer correction can converge on a shared teacher error, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because share-alike subsets require source-aware redistribution, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve CC-BY-4.0 and CC-BY-SA-4.0 subsets and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果多数答案修正可能收敛到多个教师共有的错误，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于署名相同方式共享子集要求按来源处理再分发，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 CC-BY-4.0 and CC-BY-SA-4.0 subsets 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building long-context mathematical reasoning SFT, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay answer verification, majority-answer correction metadata, source curation, and matched downstream tests. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建长上下文数学推理监督微调的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放答案验证、多数答案修正标记、来源筛选和匹配下游测试，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: Nemotron-Math generates six supervision modes per source family and packages expected answers and provenance for long-context distillation.
  • Data object: 7.5 million solution traces over 85,000 AoPS and 262,000 Math StackExchange problems; each record exposes uuid, problem, expected answers, source, messages, majority-change flag, and use split.
  • Author and selector: gpt-oss-120b generates high, medium, and low reasoning modes with and without Python TIR; retention uses answer verification, majority-answer correction metadata, source curation, and matched downstream tests.
  • Evidence anchor: On matched AoPS prompts Nemotron-Math consistently beats OpenMathReasoning, while StackExchange data improves HLE-Math; sequential bucketing trains 128K context 2-3x faster without significant reported loss.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for long-context mathematical reasoning SFT; first audit majority-answer correction can converge on a shared teacher error and share-alike subsets require source-aware redistribution.

• 定位：Nemotron-Math 为奥数与社区数学题生成 750 万条多推理预算、可选 Python 工具的长解答。
  • 数据对象：750 万条解答轨迹，覆盖 8.5 万道 AoPS 题与 26.2 万道 Math StackExchange 题，单条记录包含记录编号、题目、预期答案、来源、消息、多数修正标记和用途切分。
  • 生成与筛选：gpt-oss-120b 生成三档推理及有无 Python 工具的六种模式，并依据答案验证、多数答案修正标记、来源筛选和匹配下游测试保留。
  • 证据锚点：在匹配 AoPS 题目上，Nemotron-Math 持续超过 OpenMathReasoning；加入 StackExchange 数据提升 HLE-Math，顺序分桶还把 128K 上下文训练加速 2 至 3 倍且未报告显著损失。
  • 复用决定：适合长上下文数学推理监督微调；先审计多数答案修正可能收敛到多个教师共有的错误和署名相同方式共享子集要求按来源处理再分发。
